title: A Bring-Up Checklist for a Real Board: Ten Cheap Checks Before the First Drive, Run Against a Fake of the Board

artifact.note: BoardProbe, the lowest level of a drive board (wheel commands, encoder counts, battery, IMU, emergency stop), FakeBoard with ten kinds of fault, and run_bringup, ten checks in the order they should be made, each with a measured value and advice in words

fallback: Every check runs against FakeBoard, a model of the board and its faults; a learner with no board does the whole lesson on the fake and loses nothing but the final satisfaction of running the same function against a real board.
